title: Work-tape slots in a chunk
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $v$ be a cell value, let $i$ be a work-tape index, and let $r\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $r<3$. The chunk bit at position $h_H+3i+r$ records, according as $r=0$, $r=1$, or otherwise, whether the tape cell is nonblank, its Boolean symbol (taking false when no symbol is present), or whether the work-tape head is at that cell.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
